item.tib: sangs rgyas don yod zhags pa'i sgrub pa las gsol 'debs yid bzhin dung zhag dkar po'i le'u
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas lcags pho khyi yi 'jam dpal gshen rje brag gi gsang phug nas drangs te slad (?)phag lo rgyal rong dbang gi rgyal po bstan 'dzin bsam 'grub seng ge'i rdzong nas shog ser zhal bshus so/ de yang smin grol mchog gi bstan pa yun ring gnas par gyur cig//
